questions.content: Câu 1: Mark the letter A, B, C or D on your answer sheet to indicate the word that differs from the other three in the position of the main stress in each of the following questions.
Câu 2: Mark the letter A, B, C or D on your answer sheet to indicate the word that differs from the other three in the position of the main stress in each of the following questions.
Câu 3: Mark the letter A, B, C or D on your answer sheet to indicate the word whose underlined part differs from the other three in pronunciation in each of the following questions.
Câu 4: Mark the letter A, B, C or D on your answer sheet to indicate the word whose underlined part differs from the other three in pronunciation in each of the following questions.

Câu 5: Mark the letter A, B, C or D on your answer sheet to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions. He’s planning a trip to Hanoi and is searching ______________ cheap flights and a good hotel.

Câu 6: Mark the letter A, B, C or D on your answer sheet to indicate the word or phrase that is CLOSEST in meaning to the underlined part in each of the following questions. We have made some progress in stopping causing damage to the ozone layer, but much more needs to be done.

Câu 7: Mark the letter A, B, C or D on your answer sheet to indicate the correct answer to each of the following questions. Ho Chi Minh City is ______________ largest city in Vietnam and ______________ popular tourist destination.

Câu 8: Mark the letter A, B, C or D on your answer sheet to indicate the word or phrase that is OPPOSITE in meaning to the underlined part in each of the following questions. Hoi An is one of the most famous tourist destinations in Vietnam.
